verdict.rationale: monday.com documents an app marketplace with partner-built apps and a directory of "850+ integrations and apps." It also claims you can connect to "thousands of other tools" with no development needed, and names integrations such as Salesforce, HubSpot, GitHub, Slack, Zendesk and Mailchimp. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace's breadth or quality, and the catalog count (850+) only reaches "thousands" through a separate, unspecified connectivity claim.
